card.essence: Sepia acts primarily on the portal venous system and female pelvic organs, causing marked stasis, prolapse, and bearing-down sensations. A remedy of deep-seated weakness with indifference to loved ones, bearing-down pains ameliorated by crossing legs, and characteristic yellow discolouration (saddle across nose, moth patches). Suited to dark-haired, slender women with rigid fibre but weak pelvic support, suffering from circulatory sluggishness and profound mental and physical exhaustion.
card.sides: Left-sided predominance (headache, ovarian pains shooting backward)

keynotes.text: Bearing-down sensation as if everything would escape through vulva; must cross limbs or sit close to prevent protrusion
Indifferent to those loved best, even to family; no affection despite knowing she ought to love them
Yellow saddle across upper cheeks and nose; moth patches; sallow, waxy complexion
Sensation of a ball in inner parts (rectum, anus, uterus); during menses, pregnancy, constipation
Painful emptiness, 'all-gone' feeling at epigastrium, not relieved by eating
Flushes of heat ascending from pelvis with weakness, perspiration, and faintness; climacteric
Faints easily: from extremes of temperature, riding in carriage, kneeling at church
Enuresis during first sleep; bed wet almost as soon as child falls asleep

modalities_worse.text: Cold air, north wind, getting wet
Before menses, during pregnancy, after lactation

modalities_better.text: Violent motion, continued hard motion, dancing or walking rapidly
Sitting with legs crossed, sitting close

mentals: Indifferent to occupation, to family, to those loved best
Weeps when telling symptoms; very sad, dreads being alone
Irritable, easily offended, spiteful to those she loves
Averse to sympathy, to company, yet dreads solitude
Anxious toward evening; anxiety with fear, flushes of heat
Indolent, does not want to do anything; even thinking is an exertion
Poor memory, thinks slowly, forgetful, stupid
Stifled affections; lack of ability to feel or express natural love
Permits no opposition to her opinions
Taciturn; answers in monosyllables when pressed
Absence of all joy; life has nothing in it for her
physicals: Portal venous congestion with ptosis of viscera
Pulsating headache in cerebellum; coldness of vertex
Headache in terrific shocks at menstrual nisus with scanty flow
Hair falls out; roots of hair sensitive
Chronic post-nasal catarrh; thick greenish plugs and crusts
Muscular asthenopia; ptosis; tarsal tumours
Tongue white, clears during menses, returns when flow ceases
Taste salty, putrid; everything tastes too salty
Swelling and cracking of lower lip
Nausea at smell or sight of food; in morning before eating
Longing for vinegar, acids, pickles; loathes fat
Liver sore and painful
Constipation with large hard balls glued with mucus; feeling of ball in rectum
Prolapsus ani; almost constant oozing from anus
Urine with red adhesive sand; reddish clay-coloured sediment adherent to vessel
Leucorrhoea yellow, greenish with much itching
Menses irregular: too late and scanty or early and profuse
Violent stitches upward in vagina from uterus to umbilicus
Prolapsus of uterus and vagina
Tendency to abortion; sub-involution
Morning sickness: sight or thought of food sickens; smell of cooking nauseates
Ringworm in isolated spots on upper body
Herpes circinatus; herpes behind ears
Brown spots on abdomen, chest; liver spots
Itching of skin, genitalia, better scratching, changes to burning
clinical: Uterine prolapse and pelvic organ relaxation in tall, slender women with narrow pelvis
Menopausal flushes with weakness and perspiration
Chronic hepatic troubles with uterine reflexes in tubercular patients
Laundry-woman's remedy; complaints brought on or aggravated by laundry work
Ulceration and congestion of os and cervix uteri (supersedes local applications)
Chronic cystitis with bearing-down above pubis
Gleet, painless, yellowish, staining linen; obstinate, long-standing
Atrophic nasal catarrh with greenish crusts
Infantile diarrhoea from boiled milk with rapid exhaustion
Climacteric disorders with erethism and irregular circulation
Headaches in delicate, sensitive, hysterical women
Post-partum and post-haemorrhagic weakness with indifference

differentials.note: Puls. weepy, yielding, craves sympathy and company; Sepia indifferent, irritable, averse to sympathy. Both have changeable menses but Sepia has bearing-down and crossing legs.

Both climacteric with flushes, but Lach. left-sided, loquacious, jealous, worse tight clothing especially at neck; Sepia right-sided liver, indifferent, taciturn. Inimical; should not be used before or after.
Complementary remedy. Both have sadness, but Nat-m dwells on past grievances, consolation aggravates; Sepia indifferent to loved ones, weeps when telling symptoms.
Both have bearing-down with need to cross legs, prolapsus, but Lil-t. more hurried, frantic, fearful of insanity with cardiac symptoms.
Both have bearing-down, but Bell. acute, sudden, violent onset with heat and redness; Sepia chronic, passive congestion with weakness.
Both have flushes and venous congestion, but Sulph. more burning sensations, standing aggravates, generally hot; Sepia chilly with less burning, better violent motion.

cautions: Inimical to Lachesis; should not be used before or after (Allen, Boger)
Inimical to Pulsatilla; should never be alternated with it (Allen)
Acts best on brunettes with dark hair and rigid fibre (Allen, Kent)
Suited to chronic cases with portal stasis and pelvic relaxation, not acute inflammatory states
Tongue clears during menses, returns when flow ceases — a peculiar keynote requiring observation (Allen, Boger)
